problem: Source: "I again demand, what have _you_ to say?" — Rochester's peremptory 'demand' is softened to 'I ask again', flattening his fury at Mason; the repair also added an exclamation mark not in the source (source ends with a period after 'distinctly').
new_text: "The devil is in it if you cannot answer clearly. I demand again — what have you to say?"
